app.language_detected: Showing {language}. Tap the globe to change.
app.clock_label: Time left in the golden hour
palm.caption: My money is gone
palm.spoken: My money is gone. Press the big red button to start. It takes less than a minute.
palm.action_hint: Your case opens the moment you tap
palm.no_voice: This browser cannot speak your language. Everything still works by tapping.
safetyTriage.question: Are they still on the phone?
safetyTriage.why: Your case is already open. Nothing can delete it.
safetyTriage.hangup_spoken: Hang up now. Do not tell them anything. Do not send any more money.
safetyTriage.share_text: I may have been a victim of financial fraud. Please call me back on a number you know. Do not share any OTP or bank details with anyone.
safetyTriage.share_fallback: Message copied. Paste it to someone you trust.
messageWall.title: Which one is wrong?
messageWall.why: Look at the amount. You do not need to read the message.
messageWall.no_time_detail: This message gave a date but no time. We will not write a time we cannot see.
messageWall.upload_note: Upload a photo of your bank message. It stays on your phone.
messageWall.ocr_reading_detail: A few seconds. This happens on your device.
messageWall.ocr_unrecognized: No payment found in that image. Try a clearer photo, or pick a message above.
messageWall.correct_note: We only send what you confirm. A wrong number could freeze the wrong account.
scope.question: Only this one?
scope.why: Each payment may need its own hold.
reachedVia.question: How did they reach you?
reachedVia.why: This files your case under the right heading. You never pick a category.
readBack.question: Is this true?
readBack.why: We write the complaint. You only say yes or no.
readBack.sentence_contact: They reached you by {channel}. You did not agree to this.
readBack.sentence_filing: We will report this as a financial fraud, now.
readBack.fallback_one: You are reporting a financial fraud.
readBack.fallback_three: We will report this as a financial fraud.
readBack.channel_unknown: a way you could not identify
caseComplete.heading: Your case is open
caseComplete.spoken: Your case is open. Your reference is {reference}. Call one nine three zero and read it out.
caseComplete.your_money_detail: Send your four lines now, whichever way suits you. The sooner they have your reference, the sooner the receiving account can be held.
caseComplete.your_job_detail: Do not delete any bank message. Do not answer that number again. Send nothing more.
caseComplete.by_tomorrow_detail: Take this case, a photo ID and your bank messages to your nearest cyber crime cell.
caseComplete.not_submitted_detail: The portal has no public way for an app to file for you. Your complaint is ready — call 1930, or take the downloaded file to the portal.
calmMode.heading: When you are ready
calmMode.support: None of this is urgent. None of it was needed to open your case. Come back tomorrow if you like.
calmMode.id_prompt: A photo of any ID card
calmMode.id_note: Voter ID, licence, passport, PAN or Aadhaar. Any one.
calmMode.privacy: Your ID photo stays on this device only. It is never uploaded or saved.
guardianHandoff.title: Let someone help
guardianHandoff.support: A son, a neighbour, a bank clerk. They continue the case. It stays yours.
guardianHandoff.instruction: Open Rok again on this same device and enter this code.
guardianHandoff.not_found: No case found for that code on this device.
guardianHandoff.scope_note: In this demo the code works on this device only. Sending a case to another phone would need a server, which this build deliberately does not have.
raceView.title: NCRP today vs Rok
raceView.subtitle: The same complaint, structured for the investigator who reads it later — or for the money that is moving now.
raceView.table_caption: Every mandatory NCRP field, and how each system obtains it
raceView.source_note: Field list from cybercrime.gov.in's own pre-login instructions and FAQ. Step count from citizen procedure manuals published by Bank of India and L&T Finance.
neverAsk.otp_banner: Rok never asks for your OTP or PIN. Anyone who does is a fraud.
footer.not_official: Not an official Government of India platform — hackathon proof of concept.
error.title: Something went wrong on this screen
error.body: Your case has not been lost. Call 1930 now — they can take your report by phone.
caseComplete.reset_confirm: This clears the case from this device. Download it first if you need it.
jurisdiction.question: Where are you?
jurisdiction.why: Your complaint goes to the police in your own State. This is the only reason we ask.
jurisdiction.privacy: Your location is used on this device to shorten the list. It is never sent anywhere.
raceView.verdict: Rok is finished. The portal is on step {done} of {total}.
raceView.race_note: Real time, not accelerated. The portal's step list comes from its own pre-login instructions and from citizen procedure manuals published by Bank of India and L&T Finance; the per-step timings illustrate a competent user working steadily. Rok's timings are the journey in the concept document.
display.title: Display settings
palm.heard_nothing: We did not hear anything. Use the button instead.
caseComplete.routes_label: Send it whichever way suits you
caseComplete.written_intro: I am reporting a financial fraud. These are my case details.
